objective: Execute LNG-03 — Guided Language Construction Toolkit. Build approachable basic and advanced creator workflows for source/proposal-backed phonology, phonotactics, morphology, syntax, grammar, numerals, pronouns, tense/aspect, comparison and word formation while preserving LNG-01 temporal authority and LNG-02 lexicon/script/provenance truth. The toolkit may validate consistency and produce proposals, but it may not silently convert generated or incomplete language rules into accepted canon.
completion_summary: LNG-03 delivered deterministic provenance-bearing construction rules across ten language-construction domains; approachable five-step basic and ten-domain advanced creator workflows; explicit authored/partial/unresolved state; draft/proposed/accepted/deprecated/rejected rule status with acceptance evidence required for accepted canon; retained-source-safe empty starter rules rather than fabricated linguistic facts; authorized LNG-01 projection-first temporal/visibility filtering; LNG-02 decision consistency/contradiction findings without mutation; deterministic search/workflow/replay proofs; focused regressions, live inventory, invariant verifier and governed cross-platform validation profile. No migration 0022 or later-LNG authority was introduced.
completion_gate: A deterministic guided creator toolkit supports basic and advanced workflows for phoneme inventories, syllable/cluster/stress or other phonotactic constraints, morphology and word formation, core syntax/grammar, numerals, pronouns, tense/aspect and comparison while allowing fields to remain unresolved. Every proposal/rule is provenance-bearing and distinguishable from accepted canon; existing LNG-02 accepted/deprecated/rejected decisions can be checked for contradictions without being overwritten. The toolkit does not generate canonical vocabulary or perform historical evolution/gameplay translation. All language/stage availability inherits LNG-01 filtering. Proofs cover approachable partial authoring, advanced structured authoring, unresolved fields, contradiction findings, proposal-vs-accepted separation and deterministic replay. Exact-head repository health plus governed Windows/Linux deterministic validation passed on e7c7f61314276b39efee1582122121647fe16991.
